auth.call-ends-at-once: The call ends at once — that's normal, and it's free. Then come back here.
auth.call-dual-sim: On a two-SIM phone, call from the SIM with {phone}.
auth.call-desktop: Dial it from the phone with {phone}, not from this computer.
auth.call-slow: Call from the same phone number you typed; calls from hidden numbers can't be checked.
auth.call-expired: Time is up. Start again to call once more.
auth.call-unavailable: Missed-call sign-up is not available right now. Choose Telegram or WhatsApp instead.
auth.call-has-account: This number already has an account — sign in instead. Nothing new was created.
